questions.question: In deep-submicron integrated circuit interconnect reliability, what is the primary physical mechanism of electromigration, and what structural failure does it typically cause?
options: Momentum transfer from high-density conduction electrons to metal lattice atoms, forming voids (opens) in the cathode direction and hillocks (shorts) in the anode direction.
Direct tunneling of electrons across thin gate oxides into the silicon substrate, inducing gate pinholes and permanent threshold voltage drift.
Mechanical stress caused by differing coefficients of thermal expansion between dielectric and metal layers, leading to interlayer delamination.
High electric fields exceeding the breakdown strength of inter-layer dielectrics, causing catastrophic resistive shorting between adjacent metal tracks.
Parasitic thyristor triggering within adjacent p-wells and n-wells, resulting in a low-impedance short-circuit path between power and ground rails.

questions.question: In computer memory systems implementing paged virtual memory, what is the primary operational role of a Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB)?
options: To buffer dirty memory blocks before writing them to persistent secondary storage.
To cache recent virtual-to-physical address translations, minimizing high-latency page table lookups in main memory.
To translate variable-length CISC instructions into fixed-length micro-operations for execution units.
To resolve structural hazards in the processor pipeline caused by simultaneous instruction and data memory accesses.
To dynamically allocate contiguous physical page frames to processes to eliminate external memory fragmentation.

questions.question: In asynchronous FIFO design between two independent clock domains, why are the read and write pointers encoded in Gray code before being passed through multi-flop synchronizers?
options: Gray code requires fewer flip-flops than binary code to represent identical address depths.
Gray code simplifies the combinational logic required for arithmetic pointer increments and subtractions.
Exactly one bit changes between consecutive Gray code values, preventing multi-bit transition skew from producing invalid intermediate values during clock synchronization.
Gray code inherently prevents clock jitter and duty-cycle distortion from propagating across the clock domains.
Gray code eliminates the need for reset logic by initializing to an all-zero state on power-up.

questions.question: In digital arithmetic design, what is the primary structural advantage of utilizing a Wallace tree structure compared to an array multiplier for multi-operand partial product accumulation?
options: It eliminates the requirement for a final vector-merge carry-propagate adder stage.
It provides a perfectly regular, planar routing layout that completely eliminates routing congestion in standard cell placement.
It reduces dynamic power dissipation to zero during inactive clock cycles without requiring clock gating.
It reduces partial product reduction latency from linear O(N) to logarithmic O(log N) by summing partial products in parallel using carry-save adders without propagating carries.
It allows the multiplier to dynamically truncate lower-order partial products to adaptively adjust computational precision.

questions.question: In a high-performance processor core implementing Simultaneous Multithreading (SMT), which of the following hardware resources must be strictly replicated for each active logical thread context?
options: Arithmetic Logic Units (ALUs) and Floating-Point Units (FPUs)
Level 1 Instruction and Data Caches (L1 I-cache and D-cache)
Issue Queues and Reservation Stations
Physical Register Files and Execution Pipelines
Architectural Register State (including Program Counter and general-purpose registers)
